nodes.title: Model-as-orchestrator vs code kernel, 24 scenarios (12 original beat situations re-labelled + 12 new conflicts: safety vs plan, goodbye vs practice, goodbye after distress, build cap + child asks, money cap, strained + asks video, parent limit, consent missing, first session, ready-made only, dismissed twice, harm words in goodbye), n=3 reps/arm. Acceptable: code 23/24 [87-99% Wilson80], gpt-6-sol 69/72 [92-98], hybrid gpt-6.1-sol 70/72 [93-99], gpt-6-luna 67/72, gpt-5.6-luna 66/72, grok-4-20-nr 48/72, ds41 48/72. Hard-rule breaks: code 0 (by construction), gpt-6 family + fast 0/72 each [0-2%], grok 15/72 and ds41 15/72 [15-28%] (no-budget builds, past parent limit, build without consent x2 (ds41), no check-in after distress x1 (ds41)); hybrid 0/72 for all. Same answer x3: code 24/24, models 11-23/24. p50: code us, OpenAI 1.4-1.7 s (luna max 5.7 s), grok 0.49 s, ds41 0.76 s. $/1k decisions: luna 0.15, fast 0.30, ds41 0.35, grok 1.19, 6.1-sol 2.19, 6-sol 2.42.

Re-affirms teacher-brain-code-kernel against the newest models: code keeps the hard rules, authority order, budgets and the final per-turn/per-beat decision; models perceive (classify signals), word, build, write. A model may propose only offline (brain-sim) or as a hybrid chooser inside a code-computed allowed set, never on the live path. Reversal: a hybrid (code-filtered) model arm beats the code kernel on a learning outcome (next-item-unaided or delayed covert check) over >= 200 replayed brain-sim lessons with the 80% Wilson lower bound above code, AND fits the +100 ms turn budget (or runs off the critical path at beat boundaries with lead), AND is reproducible by seed/caching.

The code kernel's only miss (both label sets) is a Hinglish tag question ('...chubhti hai na?') read as curiosity by the '?$' regex; gpt-6-sol / 6.1-sol / 6-luna chose acceptable moves there. Fix in perception: classify piggyback emits question_curious vs tag_question; the kernel consumes the signal, never the regex.

A model (any of gpt-6-sol, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-luna, grok-4-20-non-reasoning, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) as the app's decision layer given full state + rules. What broke: no accuracy gain over code (best 69-70/72 vs 23/24, CIs overlap); grok and ds41 broke hard rules in 15/72 runs each (built with consent missing, ran past the parent's daily limit, released a child after distress without the check-in, built with no budget); even 0/72 for the gpt-6 family only bounds breaks below ~2%/decision (80%); +1.4-1.7 s p50 per decision vs a +100 ms turn budget; non-reproducible (11-23/24 stable). Hybrid (code filter + model choice) removed all breaks but gave no accuracy gain and lowered the luna models (59-62/72).

The original beat-policy label set (evals/teacher-brain/beat-policy.mjs, short-lead) marked contrast/diagram acceptable although it is a live build at lead 15 s with no library hit (a hard-rule break under TEACHER-BRAIN §6.3). Fix the label before reusing that harness; the re-labelled set is evals/model-refresh-2026-10-04/orchestration/scenarios.mjs. Owner question left open: may a strained child who asks for a video get a passive LIBRARY animation (spec says no build during strain)?

## orchestration-probe-2026-10-04
2026-10-04. Method: evals/model-refresh-2026-10-04/orchestration/run.mjs + analyze.mjs. 24 scenarios (scenarios.mjs; labels frozen sha256 35c557a8... at 2026-10-04T12:49:51Z before any arm ran; rater had seen the original harness, so not fully blind). Arms: code kernel (TEACHER-BRAIN §10.1 gates + §6.3 admissibility around the unedited original beat policy); full model orchestrator (full state + rules as notes, strict json_schema, effort low on OpenAI reasoning deployments); hybrid (code allowed-set, model picks; no call when one action allowed). n=3 reps per scenario per model arm (72), code 24. eastus2 from a US container, 810 calls, 0 errors. Splits: new 12 conflicts code 12/12, gpt-6 family full 36/36, grok 24/36 (12 breaks), ds41 20/36 (12 breaks). Move-only sensitivity (kind ignored if no hard break): code 23/24, 6.1-sol/6-luna 72/72, 6-sol 71/72. Against ORIGINAL labels on the 12: code 11/12, gpt-6-sol 31/36. Spend $1.15 (list price from usage; 6.1-sol at assumed 2/10; ds41 at Fireworks list upper bound). Caveats: synthetic states, one rater, safety/goodbye arrive as flags, no learning outcomes, no Central India timing.
md.decisions:
## code-keeps-decisions-2026-10-04
Code keeps hard rules, authority order, budgets and the final decision; models perceive, word, build, write. Model proposals only offline in brain-sim or as a chooser inside a code-computed allowed set. Rationale: orchestration-probe-2026-10-04 (no accuracy gain, 15/72 hard breaks on two models, +1.4-1.7 s, non-reproducible). Reversal: a code-filtered model arm beats the kernel on a learning outcome over >= 200 replayed brain-sim lessons (80% Wilson lower bound above code), fits the +100 ms turn budget or runs off the critical path at beat boundaries, and is reproducible.
md.rejected:
## model-full-orchestrator
Tried 2026-10-04: six models (gpt-6-sol, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-luna, grok-4-20-non-reasoning, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) as the decision layer with full state and all rules. What broke: grok and ds41 broke hard rules in 15/72 runs each, including a game built with core consent missing (ds41 x2), practice past the parent's daily limit (x3 each), release of a child after distress without the I-7 check-in (ds41 x1), live builds with no budget/first session/money cap; the gpt-6 family's 0/72 still only bounds breaks below ~2% per decision at 80%; accuracy equal to code within noise; +1.4-1.7 s p50 per decision; answers changed across reps on 1-13 of 24 scenarios. Hybrid removed all breaks but bought no accuracy.
